finalText:
Root cause: Redis died.

**Timeline (2026-07-04):**
- 02:14:07 — `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache layer fall to direct store reads.
- 02:14:08 onward — cache miss storm, every request hit store direct. Store overload, TimeoutError (5000ms) spam from api/worker-1/worker-2/scheduler on repeat, every ~2sec.
- Redis reconnect retry every ~140sec (attempts 0 through 12), all fail same ECONNREFUSED. Redis never come back.
- Request queue depth climb steady whole time: 52 at 02:14 to 568 at 02:31, past max 500 around 02:29.
- 02:31:44 — worker-2 heap out of memory (backlog pile up), crash.
- 02:31:45 — supervisor restart worker-2.
- 02:31:52 — api unresponsive, supervisor kill process group. **Service down.**

**Root cause:** Redis instance at 10.0.0.12:6379 die/unreachable. No circuit breaker on cache-miss fallback — every request hammer store direct instead of fail fast, backlog grow unbounded 17 minutes till OOM crash.

**Fix directions:** add circuit breaker/backpressure when store overload (shed load past queue max, don't just warn), fix Redis reachability (network/instance), cap worker memory or bound request queue harder.
